design: Very stocky older checkpoint guard with a barrel chest, short neck and thick forearms. Olive green speckled hide, broad heavy face with chipped outer ivory mandibular tusk, short blunt dreadlocks gathered around the collar. Low heavy dark gorget and horizontal ribbed cuirass, two small practical pauldrons, thick woven maroon waist sash, layered padded charcoal kilt, large bracers and low ankle guards exposing clawed feet. Holds a closed rectangular scanner/tool low in left hand and a sheathed stun baton at right hip; calm planted stance.
